Synopsis:
A ferry carrying 267 passengers and crew capsized shortly after departing Kyrenia, northern Cyprus, killing at least 8 and leaving 20 missing. The wreck lies at 500m+ depth. A Turkish deep-sea specialist team was deployed to assist. Some victims may be trapped in submerged compartments. Nine individuals connected to vessel operations were remanded in custody. Investigation ongoing; vessel held a valid seaworthiness certificate.
